title: Delannoy--Steinhaus triangles over $\mathbb{Z}/2\mathbb{Z}$: weight spectrum, balanced triangles, and extremal values
summary: A Delannoy--Steinhaus triangle is obtained from a finite sequence by a recurrence governed by the Delannoy numbers. We introduce this construction over $\mathbb{Z}/2\mathbb{Z}$ and study its weight distribution. The relevant Delannoy coefficients are all odd, which reduces every entry to the parity of a consecutive interval of the generating sequence. Encoding these interval parities by prefix parities yields a weight formula depending only on the numbers of zeros and ones in the prefix-parity sequence.
